# Astan Technologies
> Astan Technologies is a software development company based in Nigeria that designs and ships web apps, mobile apps, blockchain applications, ERP integrations, enterprise software, and business automation solutions.

## About
Astan Technologies builds software for startups, enterprises, and institutions across Nigeria and Africa. The company specialises in customer-facing products, AI-integrated workflows, blockchain systems, commerce platforms, and internal enterprise tools. Astan also provides custom training and enablement for teams adopting new technology.

## Services
- Web application development (React, Next.js, Node.js)
- Mobile app development (iOS and Android)
- Blockchain application development (dApps, DeFi, smart contracts)
- Bitcoin application development
- ERP and CRM integration and automation
- Enterprise software development
- Shopify and ecommerce development
- Custom team training and enablement

## Products Built
- eCarePharm: ecommerce platform for pharmacy and health product sales with Paystack integration (https://www.ecarepharm.com)
- Homa: mobile-first home management app with AI-assisted planning, grocery management, crypto wallet support, and cooperative features (https://gethoma.app)
